thread:
Ravi: Big news: I accepted a promotion to Staff Engineer this morning :tada: and also asked Sam to marry me last night :heart_eyes: Thought I:d share both because I:m on cloud nine. Low-key planning a tiny celebration in the office next Wednesday at 4pm if folks want to swing by.

Maya: WHAT ???!!! Huge congrats on both, Ravi!! :partying_face::confetti_ball: So happy for you.

Sofia: omg congrats x2!!! we need cake and terrible dad jokes.

Jon: Double celebration = double snacks. I volunteer as taste tester. :drooling_face:

Ravi: Thanks y; I can bring some sparkling sodas and will handle a small card. Any cake preferences? Quick react poll below or drop a note.

Cam: :chocolate: all the way. Also can help set up some twinkle lights.

Maya: :lemon: if available. Light and not too sweet.

Sofia: :cupcake: I say cupcakes — easier distribution.

Jon: :chocolate: (but stem to cupcakes).

Ravi: Cupcakes + mixed flavors looks like a winner. I;ll order a dozen assorted unless someone wants to handle bakery pickup.

HR Bot: Event created: https://calendar.company.internal/e/1748504321-double-celebration (Wed May 20 4:00pm  ) :calendar: Please RSVP.

Maya: Can we do a tiny photo backdrop? I have a string of fairy lights and a banner.

Cam: I;ll bring the lights and a roll of craft paper for a banner. Jon can you handle the playlist?

Jon: Consider it handled. Low-key indie + guilty-pleasure pop.

Sofia: Also, Ravi, need to know if you want a short roast segment :kidding: but we could do 2-min shoutouts. I;ll coordinate notes.

Ravi: Ha! Short roast sounds fun (but gentle please). If anyone wants to drop 1-2 lines for the card or a toast, paste them here and I;ll compile.

Maya: "Ravi : proud of you for leveling up at work and in life. Here;s to the next big adventure!"

Sofia: "You;re the best kind of engineer : brilliant and kind. Congrats on both milestones!"

Cam: "Congrats, Ravi. Can;t wait to celebrate. Save me a cupcake."
